full_text:
Article 4 (Methods of Approval and Reporting, etc.)
(1) Approvals and reports under these Rules shall be made by obtaining direct approval on relevant documents or by submitting an application for approval or a report, taking into account the urgency and complexity of the matter and considerations of security or administrative convenience.
(2) Matters concerning approvals and reports under these Rules shall be coordinated by the Director General of the Rural Policy Bureau of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
